_comment: Copy this file to generators.json and edit if needed. If generators.json is absent, the engine still uses these defaults (Evolink HTTP API). Set default_adapter to 'prompt-only' to never generate. See references/generation-adapters.md.

routing._comment: Per-format overrides on top of default_adapter. A format listed here goes to the named adapter when that adapter is configured; otherwise it falls back and the engine says so in the quote — it never silently skips a format.
routing.drama_note: drama is NOT a face_ugc format and must not be added to face_ugc_formats. Every generated clip goes to Evolink Seedance: seedance-2.0-image-to-video (full model) for speaking coverage takes, one speaking face per take, 8-15s, cut into 2-3s shots with clip in/out; seedance-2.0-fast-image-to-video for silent inserts; seedance-2.5-image-to-video (aspect_ratio adaptive) only for a variant B one-take over 15s. See references/formats/drama.md.
routing.podcast_note: podcast-duo defaults to Adsora Gen too, not Seedance. It is a two-person talking format: build it as alternating i2v clips (one speaker per clip, from that speaker's still) with H3's own native audio — NOT `avatar` mux, and split any long single-speaker beat into a chain (references/talking-head-long-form.md). Evolink Seedance is only the fallback when `node tools/adsoragen.mjs --health` is not LIVE, and the quote must say so. See references/adsoragen-video.md and references/formats/podcast-duo.md.
routing.faceless_voice_note: House Kokoro preset for faceless ads (measured ~185 wpm). A faceless ad has no avatar clip to clone from, so it never clones unless the user supplies a refAudio; cloning is for avatar-led formats only. See references/house-defaults.md.
routing.broll_pool_note: Screen every b-roll folder once (contact sheet, drop watermarked/text/logo clips) into broll-pool.json and point renders at it (brollPool). Cutaways are seeded by the script line so the same line draws the same footage in every variant.
routing._avatar_comment: Avatar-led ads (an on-camera generated person delivering hook+CTA over B-roll). The on-camera 'avatar clip' uses the BEST Seedance model, not the fast one; the voice is cloned from the avatar's own generated audio and reused for all B-roll VO. See references/formats/talking-head.md 'AVATAR-LED AD DEFAULTS'.
routing.avatar_override_note: Use avatar_clip_model and Chatterbox cloning UNLESS the user explicitly asks for another model/voice engine.

song_maker._comment: Local music/song generator (ACE-Step 1.5). No API, no key, no per-track cost (GPU time only); MLX on Apple Silicon, CUDA/CPU elsewhere. Makes songs with vocals, jingles, or instrumental beds. Used by the cartoon-music-video format (the song IS the ad) and as a fallback bed when nothing in the Soundtracks pool fits (hard rule 20). A locally generated track is yours, so it clears edit-assembly.md §9. NOT bundled with the skill (weights are ~10GB) — install ACE-Step once. Full procedure: references/song-maker.md.
song_maker.connect_note: Install ACE-Step once (see install). Model weights (~10GB) auto-download on first run, then it is offline. `node tools/song.mjs --health` reports whether it is found and ready. If absent, nothing breaks: a bed falls back to the Soundtracks pool and cartoon-music-video degrades to prompt-only (lyrics + a note to generate the song).

hands_off._comment: Used when the user kicks off with 'run it hands-off' / 'on autopilot' / 'from my phone'. The pipeline still hard-stops once for the script + avatar approval; everything after that one tap runs automatically.

evolink.connect_note: No MCP and no OAuth. Put EVOLINK_API_KEY in the .env of the folder you run from (and EVOLINK_BASE_URL if you want to override the default; it must end in /v1). Media generation is api.evolink.ai — the text/chat host direct.evolink.ai is a different service and is not used here.

field_names._comment: Evolink IGNORES unknown body keys instead of rejecting them, so a near-miss field name is billed and quietly wrong rather than erroring. These exact names matter.

adsoragen._comment: Our own MiniMax H3 weights on our own RunPod GPU, driven by tools/adsoragen.mjs. Face-to-camera UGC routes here (routing.face_ugc_formats) whenever `node tools/adsoragen.mjs --health` says LIVE. Keys live in the skill's own config/adsoragen.env (env_file), the four ComfyUI graphs in config/adsoragen/ (graph_dir). Not billed per clip — it costs GPU seconds (executionTime × RUNPOD_GPU_HOURLY). Always driven by API from this machine with every clip saved to the run folder; never generated in the web app / browser. Full procedure: references/adsoragen-video.md.

adsoragen.connect_note: Keys live in the skill's own config/adsoragen.env (cp config/adsoragen.env.example config/adsoragen.env). Fill by hand from the RunPod console, or in your own terminal: `cd ~/Documents/webchat-vercel && vercel env pull /tmp/adsora-prod.env --environment=production && node tools/adsoragen.mjs --import-env /tmp/adsora-prod.env && rm /tmp/adsora-prod.env` — that fills the key file and config/adsoragen/*.json. `node tools/adsoragen.mjs --health` names anything missing. If anything required is missing, face UGC falls back to routing.face_ugc_fallback and the quote says so. The filled key file never ships in the distributable copy.

models.avatar_lipsync: adsora-avatar-2.0 (mode avatar: reference portrait + the voice WAV; our voice muxed back over H3's picture)

defaults.seed: one per run, shared by chained clips

cost.estimate: 0.11 × (seconds/5.17)^1.47 at 480p, ×2 at 720p (superlinear; prefer several short clips)
cost.real: executionTime_ms / 3.6e6 × RUNPOD_GPU_HOURLY (default 3.49, the top of the expensive-first pool)
